Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIII OF 2000
PAKISTAN
CITIZENSHIP (AMENDMENT), ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XIII OF
2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 18th April, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
18-4-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:----
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Citizenship
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2000. '
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 5 Act II of 1951

ORDINANCE XIII OF 2000
PAKISTAN
CITIZENSHIP (AMENDMENT), ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XIII OF
2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 18th April, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
18-4-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:----
2. Amendment of section 5, Act
II of 1951.----In the. Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951. (II of 1951), in
section 5, for the word "father" wherever occurring the word
"parent" shall be substituted.
